documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: SK Minerals & Additives reported revenue of Rs. 318 crores for FY26, achieving 50% growth over FY25. The company's installed capacity stands at 6,600 metric tons, with the food and feed segments operating at 95% utilization. Management plans to invest approximately Rs. 20 crores in CAPEX across FY27 and FY28 to expand capacity in the polymer segment to 18,000 metric tons over the next 12 to 18 months.

guidance.claim: The company aims to scale its manufacturing contribution to 50% of turnover over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company to maintain its five-year growth momentum over the next two years.
guidance.quote: So, CAPEX I have answered and in terms of the foresee growth in the next two years, I think we are going to maintain the momentum which we have maintained in last five years.

demand_outlook.claim: Raw material demand picked up significantly from December onwards, driving up raw material prices in February.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we have sourced the material for next six months or suddenly there was demand from December onwards of these raw materials and the prices have increased tremendously in February of these raw materials.

demand_outlook.claim: SK Minerals & Additives is initially focusing its flame-retardant products on cable and wire, as well as electrical and electronics equipment industries.
demand_outlook.quote: This flame-retardant is being used in various industries, but currently, we are focusing on cable and wire and electrical and electronics equipment.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has received initial inquiries from international buyers for its halogen-free flame retardant products.
demand_outlook.quote: As currently, we are getting a few queries from the international buyers also.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned Rs. 20 crore CAPEX is specifically intended for developing polymer segment additives and compounding facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: It is for polymer additives. The food we have already set up a plant for. This is going to be specifically in polymer segment where we are developing additives and compounding facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired a 9.6-acre land parcel to establish its polymer additives and compounding facility.
capex_expansion.quote: First of all, this 9.6 acre land which we have taken is for developing our polymer additives and polymer compound facility, whereas specified that in next 12 to 18 months, we will be taking our manufacturing capabilities to 18,000 metric tons.

margins_costs.claim: Profit margins contracted in the second half of FY26 due to raw material price increases beginning in January.
margins_costs.quote: It is because of the increase in the prices of raw materials. And as I have said prices have increased specifically, from January onwards, the prices of raw material have increased.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins stand at approximately 30% for manufactured products and 21% for trading products.
margins_costs.quote: So, in terms of gross margin, which we make from manufacturing, right now it's 30%. Whereas, in terms of our trading product, it is 21%.

margins_costs.claim: Management projects margins for polymer additives to reach around 40%.
margins_costs.quote: Currently, in terms of the manufacturing margins, we are standing at 30% approximately, whereas from polymer additives, we feel that the margins would be 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes increased to 46,000 metric tons in FY26 from 33,000 metric tons in FY25.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the volume was 33,000 metric ton in FY25 and this year it was 46,000 metric ton in 2026, which comprises of 4,400 metric ton of manufacturing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds an order book of approximately Rs. 55 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, order book is around about Rs. 55 crore and it depends upon the customer.

orders_capacity.claim: Government contracts account for Rs. 42 crores of the Rs. 55 crore order book, with the remaining balance coming from private customers.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of these Rs. 55 crores, Rs. 42 crores is from government and rest is from private.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity stands at 6,600 metric tons with overall utilization at 70%, while food and feed segments operate at 95% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The current capacity is 6600 metric tons. And as we have added polymer additives, which is 450 metric tons per month, which is going to live in the next three months. So, the current capacity is 70%. Food and feed is being running at 95%, and the polymer additive industry is yet to get live in the next three months.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's working capital cycle is currently at 110 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, working capital cycle is of 110 days. We are trying to reduce this working capital cycle because it will improve in cash flow also in the organization.

capital_allocation.claim: CAPEX funding will be drawn from available bank credit lines and unutilized IPO proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: We have the credit lines available for CAPEX from the banks also. And we have some part of the IPO proceeds which we have raised for CAPEX. So, we will utilize both for taking our capacity to next level to 18,000 metric tons.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical disruptions have impacted import trading inventory by depleting the company's typical three-month raw material stock.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of the import trading, yes, it has impacted because we have three months’ stock always available with us. So, that stock is getting dried up.

risks_headwinds.claim: The newly commissioned 400 metric ton per month polymer additives plant experienced initial teething issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to maintain its past five-year growth momentum over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So, CAPEX I have answered and in terms of the foresee growth in the next two years, I think we are going to maintain the momentum which we have maintained in last five years.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to file three patents over the next six months.
management_commitments.quote: But in next six months, we will try to file three patents.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to resolve teething issues at the polymer additives facility in three months and reach full utilization within six months.
management_commitments.quote: In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
